description: Secrets guardrail bypass events — bypass rate by layer/actor/rule, annotated-bypass aging, critical-event timeline, expiring-annotation panel. Phase 7b.3 dashboard. Source: apps/security-events-collector stdout → Promtail (job=secrets-guardrails) → Loki, with secrets_guardrail_bypass_total Prometheus counter via Promtail metrics pipeline stage.

panels.title: Critical-event timeline (severity=critical, 7d)
panels.description: A non-zero stack on this panel is paged via secforge.secrets-guardrails alert group (see infrastructure/observability/13-alerting-rules.yaml). Hover to see which rule fired.

panels.title: Annotated-bypass aging — recent escape-hatch events (Loki tail, 7d)
panels.description: Pods admitted under the secforge.local/legacy-secret-env escape hatch. Source: legacy-env-warner CronJob daily emissions + ad-hoc admission events. Each line includes annotation_ref (ticket id), resource, and the warner's expiry-date payload — sort by ts desc to see most recent first. Note: until operator-backlog #12 (api-auth service-tier DPoP gap) lands, only the rejection-path events flow; annotated-bypass events from in-cluster CronJobs land in collector stdout but get scrubbed to outcome=blocked because the warner's wget cannot mint DPoP-bound tokens. The dashboard shows what flows today.

panels.title: Expiring-annotation panel — escape hatches expiring within 14 days (Loki tail, 24h)
panels.description: Last 24h of legacy-env-warner emissions filtered to rule=legacy-secret-env-expiry-warning-14d. The warner CronJob runs daily at 06:00 UTC and emits one event per Pod whose secforge.local/legacy-secret-env-expires annotation falls within 14 days. Sort by ts asc to see closest-to-expiry first; the resource field carries the Pod name and annotation_ref carries the ticket. If the panel is empty after a 06:00 UTC window, no Pods are within the 14-day window OR the warner couldn't reach the collector (currently the case under operator-backlog #12).

panels.title: Rejected probes (collector.auth failures — outcome=blocked, last 1h)
panels.description: Synthesized rejection events emitted by the collector when auth fails (per ADR-0013 § Webhook receiver auth — silent-rejection-doesn't-mask-probing guarantee). Spikes here imply either an active probe of the collector endpoint OR that an in-cluster emitter is mis-auth'd; cross-reference with operator-backlog #12 (CronJob path is currently expected to land here, not in the annotated-bypass panel above).
